description: BTC-first H4-draw-aligned completed-session raid/reclaim transfer to first unconsumed source-session or HTF liquidity

cost_assumptions.rationale: Every fill is charged 6 bp. Entry reserves one adverse tick; stop execution reserves the shifted 99th percentile of completed ten-second true range over the preceding hour. Ten-second data is execution infrastructure, not an alpha input. NautilusTrader separately settles checksum-verified official funding and applies native liquidation.
cost_assumptions.actual_funding_settlement: checksum-verified Binance Vision monthly fundingRate archives; funding_interval_hours converted to Nautilus minutes
cost_assumptions.stop_market_slippage_reserve: Shifted 99th percentile of completed ten-second true range over the preceding 60 minutes, minimum one tick; independent of direction, target and outcome.

scenario_contract.direction: Completed H4 displacement close through a causally confirmed H4 swing.
scenario_contract.context: Completed Asia inventory routes Europe; completed Europe inventory routes US.
scenario_contract.confirmation: A completed destination-session 15-minute bar raids the source boundary opposite the H4 draw and closes back inside.
scenario_contract.execution_location: The first later completed five-minute touch of the reclaimed boundary must close inside and with the draw; entry uses the first later completed ten-second bucket.
scenario_contract.target: Nearest still-unconsumed source-session opposite boundary or already-frozen completed day/week/H4 target. No fitted-R target.
scenario_contract.stop: Observed 15-minute raid extreme plus fixed 0.05 five-minute ATR buffer.
scenario_contract.position_location: Long only in the lower half and short only in the upper half of the completed source range.
scenario_contract.expiry: Route end or invalid first boundary retest, draw change, target consumption, or failed cost geometry.
scenario_contract.holding_horizon: Tens of minutes to six hours; intraday only.

single_ablation.retained: Boundary touch and inside close, H4 draw, session raid, source-range location, target, stop, costs, funding, current shared NAV 3 percent risk
